text: This credit card pays me to invest, and I finally got approved for it.
And let me tell you, as someone who's addicted to investing, this is the best credit card I could have.
I spend around two thousand five hundred dollars a month on bills and everyday stuff.
At three percent cashback on that spending, I'm looking at about seventy-five dollars a month.
That's around nine hundred dollars a year before the Gold Membership cost.
Now, here's how I actually get that money into my portfolio.
When I use the card, I earn points.
I can go into the Rewards tab, turn those points into cash, and send it to my Robinhood investing account.
From there, I can use that cash to buy stocks or ETFs.
I'm putting mine straight into more ETFs.
I'm sticking to my regular spending and paying the card off in full every month.
Once my first statement comes in, I'll show you how much I actually earned.
